extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians, navigators, and advanced students of analytical geometry
extracted.subtask_description: Expository mathematical paper presenting formulas and procedures for transforming coordinates between oblique and rectangular axes, methods to obtain directing cosines and projecting coefficients, and a detailed analysis of Mercator's projection (projection of great circles) including curvature, evolute, and arc-length expressions; also includes a short result on equal tangents to a parabola.
